say:2:1520422002:0.text: Huh? Weren't you the ones who stopped us outside Halia? What are you doing here?
say:2:1520422002:0.source_cn: 嗯？你们不是之前在呼临城外阻拦我们的那些人吗？怎么也过来了？

say:4:1520422003:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the others were worried about you, so we came to check.
say:4:1520422003:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the others were worried about you, so we came to check.
say:4:1520422003:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the others were worried about you, so we came to check.

say:5:1520422004:0.text: And just as we feared, you're all sick.

say:6:1520422005:0.text: *Sigh* You were right. There hasn't been food here for a long time...
say:6:1520422005:0.source_cn: 唉……你们说的没错，这里果然早就没有食物了……

choice_prompt:7:1520422005.text: *Sigh* You were right. There hasn't been food here for a long time...
choice_prompt:7:1520422005.source_cn: 唉……你们说的没错，这里果然早就没有食物了……

say:8:1520422006:1.text: The rotten meat was piled nearby... We were starving and had no choice.
say:8:1520422006:1.source_cn: 这些烂掉的肉就堆在附近。我们饿极了，实在没的选……

say:9:1520422007:0.text: It only smelled a little sour. We thought boiling it into soup would make it safe. Never thought it'd make us this sick...
say:9:1520422007:0.source_cn: 本来想着只是闻起来有点馊，熬成汤应该可以喝。真没想到喝...

say:10:1520422008:0.text: Good thing you all came. Otherwise, we might've died here...
say:10:1520422008:0.source_cn: 幸好你们过来了。要不然的话，我们的命可能就要交代在这里了……
